uniform_symmetry_control.lemma: For a uniform invertible basis T, leg permutations commute with T^{tensor 6}; therefore the exact permutation stabilizer is unchanged. Since |Stab(F)|=4 rather than 720, no uniform basis makes F fully symmetric.

full_portwise_symmetrization_obstruction.portwise_basis_invariance: For G=T_1 tensor ... tensor T_6 with each T_i invertible, the flattening across a named cut A|A^c is left- and right-multiplied by invertible Kronecker matrices. Therefore its matrix rank is invariant for every named bipartition.
full_portwise_symmetrization_obstruction.symmetric_tensor_lemma: For a fully symmetric six-leg tensor, S6 acts transitively on all k-subsets. Hence all k|(6-k) flattenings have equal rank for fixed k.
full_portwise_symmetrization_obstruction.certificate: F has three distinct ranks on 2|4 cuts and three distinct ranks on 3|3 cuts. These named-cut ranks cannot change anywhere in the GL(3)^6 orbit.
full_portwise_symmetrization_obstruction.consequence: The symmetric real-valued domain-3 Holant* dichotomy cannot be reached from this local signature by any independent invertible change of basis on the six ports, not merely by a uniform transform.
full_portwise_symmetrization_obstruction.scope: This still does not exclude an intrinsically asymmetric tractable Holant class, edge-compatible gadget transformation, matchgate/Pfaffian structure, or a graph-global cancellation.

portwise_product_obstruction.basis_invariance_lemma: The same cut-rank invariance applies under arbitrary invertible portwise bases.
portwise_product_obstruction.certificate: Every nontrivial cut has flattening rank greater than one.
portwise_product_obstruction.scope: This does not rule out sums of products, matchgate/Pfaffian varieties, bounded auxiliary bond dimension, or graph-global cancellations.
